title: StoreWay
subtitle: Hyperlocal Retail Platform
description: A hyperlocal digital commerce platform that empowers neighborhood retailers to digitize their storefronts, automate catalog creation via AI-driven invoice OCR, and fulfill local orders without centralized warehouse dependencies.
impact: 85% reduction in merchant onboarding time and enabled sub-30-minute localized delivery across pilot retail clusters.

howItWorks.title: AI Invoice Ingestion
howItWorks.description: OCR extracts SKU names, prices, and quantities directly from paper wholesaler receipts to populate inventory instantly.

howItWorks.title: Geospatial Storefront Discovery
howItWorks.description: Google Maps API connects buyers with nearby stores within walking or biking radius for immediate pickup and direct delivery.

howItWorks.title: Real-Time Merchant Hub
howItWorks.description: Firebase-backed real-time synchronization for localized order dispatch, inventory deduction, and daily sales metrics.
